question: On what grounds could a manyfold division of the path be merely imagined rather than real, given a difference arising from effect?
premises: A division of the path is posited for consideration.
Such a division could be imagined rather than ontologically real.
A manyfold division may arise by particularity due to effect.
inference: A manyfold division of the path is admissible as imagined on account of particularity due to effect.
uncertainties: It is not yet determined in this verse whether the division is ultimately real or merely imagined.
plain_english: This may be an imagined manyfold division, arising by particularity due to effect.
